title: Spec drops the per-test reset, so tasks leak into later tests
summary: e2e/tasks.spec.ts no longer resets the store in beforeEach, so the task created by the previous test remains in the shared store; "completing a task updates the counter and the Done filter" then sees an active count of 2 where it expects 1. Ground truth: the missing reset in the TEST (state leak) is the defect; the app behavior is intended.

expectedFailure.testTitle: completing a task updates the counter and the Done filter
